key_points: DOJ closed its antitrust probe into NextEra's $66.8B Dominion acquisition after New England power-price safeguards were agreed — the biggest single regulatory overhang on the deal is removed
Virginia SCC hearings on the merger are the next gating item; procedural and expected, but headline risk around state pricing/reliability conditions remains
Deal would materially expand NEE's regulated utility footprint and load-growth exposure to data-center demand, reinforcing the long-term growth thesis
Remaining coverage (utility ETF comparisons, dividend/income screens, Southern's capex debate, Druckenmiller/Einhorn notes) is generic sector commentary and noise for NEE
Net: modestly positive risk/reward on improved deal-certainty; watch for Virginia conditions or DOJ safeguard follow-through as the swing factors
